name: Credit Default Swap Index 3
definition: Credit default swap derivative specific for reporting derivatives on a credit default swap index.

UnderlyingIndexIdentification.name: Underlying Index Identification
UnderlyingIndexIdentification.definition: Derivative on a credit default swap with the ISIN code of the underlying index.

UnderlyingIndexName.name: Underlying Index Name
UnderlyingIndexName.definition: To be populated for derivatives on a CDS index with the standardized name of the index.

Series.name: Series
Series.definition: Series number of the composition of the index if applicable.

Version.name: Version
Version.definition: New version of a series is issued if one of the constituents defaults and the index has to be re-weighted to account for the new number of total constituents within the index.

RollMonth.name: Roll Month
RollMonth.definition: All months when the roll is expected as established by the index provider for a given year. Field should be repeated for each month in the roll.

NextRollDate.name: Next Roll Date
NextRollDate.definition: To be populated in the case of a CDS Index or a derivative CDS Index with the next roll date of the index as established by the index provider.

NotionalCurrency.name: Notional Currency
NotionalCurrency.definition: Currency in which the notional is denominated.
